en: If this is your first time playing, please heed the embark warnings about aquifers, saltwater, and other hazards. Some locations are challenging even for experienced players, and it will be a very short game indeed if you don't know how to deal with them! [B] After you embark, help is available by pressing the help button in the top right corner, including all of the tutorials.
zh-Hant: 如果這是你第一次玩，請留意出發時關於含水層、鹽水和其他危險的警告。有些地點連老手都覺得棘手，要是不知道怎麼應付，這局很快就會結束！[B]出發之後，按右上角的說明按鈕就能取得協助，所有教學也都在那裡。
